Ações Específicas (Parcial / Editar)\n  const [partialPayId, setPartialPayId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [partialAmount, setPartialAmount] = useState('');\n  \n  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ item: '', value: '' });\n\n  // Confirmação State (Substitui window.confirm)\n  const [confirmAction, string, val: string) => {\n    setBatchQuantities(prev => ({ ...prev, [itemId]: val }));\n  };\n\n  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {\n    return (section.items || []).filter(i => i.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));\n  }, [section.items, searchTerm]);\n\n  const filteredExpenses = useMemo(() => {\n    return (section.expenses || []).filter(e => pending = transactions.filter(t => \n      t.workspaceId === section.workspaceId && \n      t.isPending && \n      t.subCategory !== 'GASTOS'\n    );\n    \n    const groups: Record<string, { total: number, ids: string[], count: number, items: Transaction[] }> = {};\n    pending.forEach(t => {\n      const name = t.customerName || 'Cliente Sem Nome';\n      if (!groups[name]) groups[name] = { total: 0, ids: [], count: 0, items: [] };\n      groups[name].total += t.value;\n      groups[name].ids.push(t.id);\n      groups[name].count += 1;\n      groups[name].items.push(t);\n    });\n    return groups;\n  }, [transactions, section.workspaceId]);\n\n  // Limpar seleções ao fechar modal\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!viewingCustomer) {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set());\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setConfirmAction(null);\n    }\n  }, [viewingCustomer]);\n\n  const batchTotal = useMemo(() => {\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n      return section.items.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const qty = parseFloat(batchQuantities[item.id] || '0');\n        const price = globalMethod === 'A_VISTA' \n          ? (item.defaultPriceAVista || item.defaultPrice || 0)\n          : (item.defaultPriceAPrazo || item.defaultPrice || 0);\n        return acc + (qty * price);\n      }, 0);\n    } else if (activeTab === 'GASTOS') {\n      return section.expenses.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const val = parseFloat(batchQuantities[item.id] || '0');\n        return acc + val;\n      }, 0);\n    }\n    return 0;\n  }, [activeTab, batchQuantities, section.items, section.expenses, globalMethod]);\n\n  const formatCurrency = (val: number) => \n    new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(val);\n\n  const confirmBatch = async () => {\n    if (batchTotal <= 0) return;\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS' && globalMethod === 'A_PRAZO' && !customerName) {\n      alert(\"Informe o nome do cliente para venda a prazo.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    const newTx: Omit<Transaction, 'id' | 'date'>[] = [];\n\n    try {\n      if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, qtyStr]) => {\n          const qty = parseFloat(qtyStr as string);\n          if (qty > 0) {\n            const item = section.items.find(i => i.id === itemId);\n            if (item) {\n              const price = globalMethod === 'A_VISTA' \n                ? (item.defaultPriceAVista || item.defaultPrice || 0)\n                : (item.defaultPriceAPrazo || item.defaultPrice || 0);\n              \n              newTx.push({\n                workspaceId: section.workspaceId,\n                category: section.name,\n                subCategory: 'VENDAS',\n                item: item.name,\n                value: qty * price,\n                quantity: qty,\n                paymentMethod: globalMethod,\n                customerName: globalMethod === 'A_PRAZO' ? customerName : undefined,\n                isPending: globalMethod === 'A_PRAZO',\n                createdBy: user.name,\n                unitPrice: price\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      } else {\n        // GASTOS\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, valStr]) => {\n          const val = parseFloat(valStr as string);\n          if (val > 0) {\n            const item = section.expenses.find(i => i.id === itemId);\n            if (item) {\n              newTx.push({\n                workspaceId: section.workspaceId,\n                category: section.name,\n                subCategory: 'GASTOS',\n                item: item.name,\n                value: val,\n                paymentMethod: 'A_VISTA',\n                isPending: false,\n                createdBy: user.name\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      await addTransactions(newTx);\n      setBatchQuantities({});\n      setCustomerName('');\n      alert(\"Lançamento realizado com sucesso!\");\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error(e);\n      alert(\"Erro ao salvar.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // --- ACTIONS HANDLERS ---\n\n  const toggleGroupSelection = (ids: string[]) => {\n    const allSelected = ids.every(id => selectedIds.has(id));\n    const newSet = new Set(selectedIds);\n    \n    if (allSelected) {\n      // Desmarcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.delete(id));\n    } else {\n      // Marcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.add(id));\n    }\n    setSelectedIds(newSet);\n  };\n\n  const toggleSelectAll = (ids: string[]) => {\n    if (selectedIds.size === ids.length) {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set());\n    } else {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set(ids));\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSettle = async (ids: string[]) => {\n    if (ids.length === 0) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      if (viewingCustomer) {\n        await settleCustomerDebt(viewingCustomer, ids);\n        // Se baixou tudo, fecha o modal\n        if (pendingByCustomer[viewingCustomer] && pendingByCustomer[viewingCustomer].ids.length === ids.length) {\n           setViewingCustomer(null);\n        } else {\n           // Limpa seleção\n           setSelectedIds(new Set());\n           setConfirmAction(null);\n        }\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executePartialPay = async (t: Transaction) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(partialAmount.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!val || val <= 0 || val >= t.value) {\n      alert(\"Valor inválido para pagamento parcial.\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await partialSettleTransaction(t, val);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setPartialAmount('');\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeEdit = async (id: string) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(editForm.value.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!editForm.item || isNaN(val)) return;\n    \n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await updateTransaction(id, { item: editForm.item, value: val });\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeDelete = async (id: string) => {\n    if (deleteTransaction) {\n      setIsSaving(true);\n      try {\n        await deleteTransaction(id);\n        setConfirmAction(null);\n        setMenuOpenId(null);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSaving(false);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const generatePDF = (items: Transaction[], customerName: string) => {\n    const doc = new jsPDF();\n    const dateStr = new Date(items[0].date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');\n    \n    doc.setFillColor(249, 115, 22); // Orange\n    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 20, 'F');\n    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);\n    doc.setFontSize(16);\n    doc.text(\"COMPROVANTE DE PEDIDO\", 105, 13, { align: \"center\" });\n    \n    doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);\n    doc.setFontSize(10);\n    doc.text(`Cliente: ${customerName}`, 14, 30);\n    doc.text(`Data do Pedido: ${dateStr}`, 14, 35);\n    doc.text(`Emitido em: ${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`, 14, 40);\n\n    const tableData = items.map(t => [\n      t.item.toUpperCase(),\n      t.quantity ? t.quantity.toString() : '-',\n      new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(t.value)\n    ]);\n\n    const total = items.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.value, 0);\n\n    autoTable(doc, {\n      head: [['Item', 'Qtd', 'Valor']],\n      body: tableData,\n      startY: 45,\n      theme: 'striped',\n      foot: [['', 'TOTAL', new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(total)]],\n      footStyles: { fillColor: [249, 115, 22], textColor: [255, 255, 255], fontStyle: 'bold' }\n    });\n\n    doc.save(`Pedido_${customerName}_${dateStr.replace(/\\//g, '-')}.pdf`);\n  };\n\n  // Helper para agrupar itens por data no modal\n  const getItemsByDate = (items: Transaction[]) => {\n    const groups: Record<string, Transaction[]> = {};\n    items.forEach(item => {\n      // Agrupa por timestamp completo para manter items da mesma \"Nota\" juntos\n      const key = item.date; \n      if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = [];\n      groups[key].push(item);\n    });\n    // Ordena do mais recente para o mais antigo\n    return */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white p-2 rounded-[2rem] shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar\">\n        <button \n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('VENDAS')} \n      <p className=\"text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest\">Nenhuma pendência</p>\n             </div>\n           ) : (\n             </div>\n             ))\n           )}\n        </div>\n      ) : (\n        <>\n          <div className=\"bg-white p-6 rounded-[2.5rem] shadow-xl border border-slate-50 space-y-4\">\n setConfirmAction(null);\n    }\n  }, [viewingCustomer]);\n\n  const batchTotal = useMemo(() => {\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n      return section.items.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const          createdBy: user.name,\n                unitPrice: price\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      } else {\n        // GASTOS\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, valStr]) => {\n          const val = parseFloat(valStr as string);\n          if (val > 0) {\n            const item = section.expenses.find(i => i.id               item: item.name,\n                value: val,\n                paymentMethod: 'A_VISTA',\n                isPending: false,\n                createdBy: user.name\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      await addTransactions(newTx);\n      setBatchQuantities({});\n      setCustomerName('');\n      alert(\"Lançamento realizado com sucesso!\");\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error(e);\n      alert(\"Erro ao salvar.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // --- ACTIONS HANDLERS ---\n\n  const toggleGroupSelection = ids.forEach(id => newSet.delete(id));\n    } else {\n      // Marcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.add(id));\n    }\n    setSelectedIds(newSet);\n  };\n\n  const toggleSelectAll = setViewingCustomer(null);\n        } else {\n           // Se foi parcial, apenas limpa seleção e modal de confirmação\n           setSelectedIds(new Set());\n           setConfirmAction(null);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error(\"Erro ao baixar:\", e);\n      alert(\"Ocorreu um erro ao processar a baixa. Tente novamente.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executePartialPay = async (t: Transaction) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(partialAmount.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!val || val <= 0 || val >= t.value) {\n      alert(\"Valor inválido para pagamento parcial.\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await partialSettleTransaction(t, val);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setPartialAmount('');\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeEdit = async (id: string) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(editForm.value.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!editForm.item || isNaN(val)) return;\n    \n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await updateTransaction(id, { item: editForm.item, value: val });\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeDelete = async (id: string) => {\n    if (deleteTransaction) {\n      setIsSaving(true);\n      try {\n        await deleteTransaction(id);\n        setConfirmAction(null);\n        setMenuOpenId(null);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSaving(false);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const generatePDF = (items: Transaction[], customerName: string) => {\n    const doc = new jsPDF();\n    const dateStr = new Date(items[0].date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');\n    \n    doc.setFillColor(249, 115, 22); // Orange\n    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 20, 'F');\n    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);\n    doc.setFontSize(16);\n    doc.text(\"COMPROVANTE DE PEDIDO\", 105, 13, { align: \"center\" });\n    \n    doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);\n    doc.setFontSize(10);\n    doc.text(`Cliente: ${customerName}`, 14, 30);\n    doc.text(`Data do Pedido: ${dateStr}`, 14, 35);\n    doc.text(`Emitido em: ${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`, 14, 40);\n\n    const tableData = items.map(t => [\n      t.item.toUpperCase(),\n      t.quantity ? 'SETTLE_SELECTED' | 'DELETE' | 'SETTLE_NOTE', \n    id?: string,\n    ids?: string[]\n  } | null>(null);\n\n  const hideMoney = user.hideSalesValues;\n\n  const handleQtyChange = (itemId: string, val: string) => {\n    setBatchQuantities(prev => ({ ...prev, [itemId]: val }));\n  };\n\n  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {\n    return (section.items || []).filter(i => i.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));\n  }, [section.items, searchTerm]);\n\n  const filteredExpenses = useMemo(() => {\n    return (section.expenses || []).filter(e => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));\n  }, [section.expenses, searchTerm]);\n\n  // Sugestões de Clientes\n  const customerSuggestions = useMemo(() => {\n    if (!customerName || customerName.length < 1) return [];\n    const lowerTerm = customerName.toLowerCase();\n    return customers.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerTerm)).slice(0, 5);\n  }, [customers, customerName]);\n\n  // Agrupamento de Pendências (A Receber)\n  const pendingByCustomer = useMemo(() => {\n    const pending = transactions.filter(t => \n      t.workspaceId === section.workspaceId && \n      t.isPending && \n      t.subCategory !== 'GASTOS'\n    );\n    \n    const groups: Record<string, { total: number, ids: string[], count: number, items: Transaction[] }> = {};\n    pending.forEach(t => {\n      const name = t.customerName || 'Cliente Sem Nome';\n      if (!groups[name]) groups[name] = { total: 0, ids: [], count: 0, items: [] };\n      groups[name].total += seleções ao fechar modal\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!viewingCustomer) {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set());\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setConfirmAction(null);\n    }\n  }, [viewingCustomer]);\n\n  const batchTotal = useMemo(() => {\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n      return section.items.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const (item.defaultPriceAVista || item.defaultPrice || 0)\n          : (item.defaultPriceAPrazo || item.defaultPrice || 0);\n        return acc + (qty * price);\n      }, 0);\n    } else if (activeTab === 'GASTOS') {\n      return section.expenses.reduce((acc, item) => {\n        const val = parseFloat(batchQuantities[item.id] || '0');\n        return acc + val;\n      }, 0);\n    }\n    return 0;\n  }, [activeTab, batchQuantities, section.items, section.expenses, globalMethod]);\n\n  const formatCurrency = (val: number) => \n    new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(val);\n\n  const confirmBatch = async () => {\n    if (batchTotal <= 0) return;\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS' && globalMethod === 'A_PRAZO' && !customerName) {\n      alert(\"Informe o nome do cliente para venda a prazo.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    const newTx: Omit<Transaction, 'id' | 'date'>[] = [];\n\n    try {\n      if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, qtyStr]) => {\n          const qty = parseFloat(qtyStr as string);\n          if (qty > 0) {\n            const item = section.items.find(i => i.id === itemId);\n            if (item) {\n              const price = globalMethod === 'A_VISTA' \n                ? (item.defaultPriceAVista || item.defaultPrice || 0)\n                : (item.defaultPriceAPrazo || item.defaultPrice || 0);\n              \n              newTx.push({\n                workspaceId:          createdBy: user.name,\n                unitPrice: price\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      } else {\n        // GASTOS\n        Object.entries(batchQuantities).forEach(([itemId, valStr]) => {\n          const val = parseFloat(valStr as string);\n          if (val > 0) {\n            const item = section.expenses.find(i => i.id               item: item.name,\n                value: val,\n                paymentMethod: 'A_VISTA',\n                isPending: false,\n                createdBy: user.name\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      await addTransactions(newTx);\n      setBatchQuantities({});\n      setCustomerName('');\n      alert(\"Lançamento realizado com sucesso!\");\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error(e);\n      alert(\"Erro ao salvar.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // --- ACTIONS HANDLERS ---\n\n  const toggleGroupSelection = (ids: string[]) => {\n    const allSelected = ids.every(id => selectedIds.has(id));\n    const newSet = new Set(selectedIds);\n    \n    if (allSelected) {\n      // Desmarcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.delete(id));\n    } else {\n      // Marcar todos deste grupo\n      ids.forEach(id => newSet.add(id));\n    }\n    setSelectedIds(newSet);\n  };\n\n  const toggleSelectAll = (ids: string[]) => {\n    if (selectedIds.size === ids.length) {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set());\n    } else {\n      setSelectedIds(new Set(ids));\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSettle = async (ids: string[]) => {\n    if (ids.length === 0) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      if (viewingCustomer) {\n        // Aguarda a atualização (agora otimista no hook)\n        await baixar:\", e);\n      alert(\"Ocorreu um erro ao processar a baixa. Tente novamente.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executePartialPay = async (t: Transaction) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(partialAmount.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!val || val <= 0 || val >= t.value) {\n      alert(\"Valor inválido para pagamento parcial.\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await partialSettleTransaction(t, val);\n      setPartialPayId(null);\n      setPartialAmount('');\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeEdit = async (id: string) => {\n    const val = parseFloat(editForm.value.replace(',', '.'));\n    if (!editForm.item || isNaN(val)) return;\n    \n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await updateTransaction(id, { item: editForm.item, value: val });\n      setEditingId(null);\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeDelete = async (id: string) => {\n    if (deleteTransaction) {\n      setIsSaving(true);\n      try {\n        await deleteTransaction(id);\n        setConfirmAction(null);\n        setMenuOpenId(null);\n      } finally {\n        setIsSaving(false);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const generatePDF = (items: Transaction[], customerName: string) => {\n    const doc = new jsPDF();\n    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');\n    \n    doc.setFillColor(249, 115, 22); // Orange\n    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 20, 'F');\n    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);\n    doc.setFontSize(16);\n    doc.text(\"COMPROVANTE DE PEDIDO\", 105, 13, { align: \"center\" });\n    \n    doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);\n    doc.setFontSize(10);\n    doc.text(`Cliente: ${customerName}`, 14, 30);\n    doc.text(`Data de Emissão: ${dateStr}`, 14, 35);\n\n    const tableData = items.map(t => [\n      new Date(t.date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'),\n      t.item.toUpperCase(),\n      t.quantity ? t.quantity.toString() : '-',\n      new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(t.value)\n    ]);\n\n    const total = items.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.value, 0);\n\n    autoTable(doc, {\n      head: [['Data', 'Item', 'Qtd', 'Valor']],\n      body: tableData,\n      startY: 45,\n      theme: 'striped',\n      foot: [['', '', 'TOTAL', new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(total)]],\n      footStyles: { fillColor: [249, 115, 22], textColor: [255, 255, 255], fontStyle: 'bold' }\n    });\n\n    doc.save(`Extrato_${customerName}_${dateStr.replace(/\\//g, '-')}.pdf`);\n  };\n\n  const handlePrintSelected = () => {\n    if (!viewingCustomer || selectedIds.size === 0) return;\n    const items = pendingByCustomer[viewingCustomer].items.filter(i => selectedIds.has(i.id));\n    generatePDF(items, viewingCustomer);\n  };\n\n  // Helper para agrupar itens por data no modal\n  const getItemsByDate = (items: Transaction[]) => {\n    const groups: Record<string, Transaction[]> = {};\n    items.forEach(item => {\n      // Agrupa por timestamp completo para manter items da mesma \"Nota\" juntos\n      const key = item.date; \n      if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = [];\n      groups[key].push(item);\n    });\n    // Ordena do mais recente para o mais antigo\n    return Object.entries(groups).sort((a, b) => new Date(b[0]).getTime() - new Date(a[0]).getTime());\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"space-y-6 pb-24 animate-in fade-in\">\n      {/* Header / Tabs */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white p-2 rounded-[2rem] shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar\">\n        <button \n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('VENDAS')} \n          className={`flex-1 py-4 px-4 rounded-[1.6rem] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${activeTab === 'VENDAS' ?             </div>\n             ))\n           )}\n        </div>\n      ) : (\n        <>\n          <div className=\"bg-white p-6 rounded-[2.5rem] shadow-xl border border-slate-50 space-y-4\">\n  isPending: false,\n                createdBy: user.name\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        });\n      }\n      await addTransactions(newTx);\n      setBatchQuantities({});\n      setCustomerName('');\n      alert(\"Lançado!\");\n    } catch (e) {\n      alert(\"Erro ao salvar.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSettle = async (ids: // GARANTE QUE O LOADING PARE, independente de erros\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Funções de Seleção\n  const toggleGroupSelection = (ids: string[]) => {\n    const allSelected = groups[key].push(item);\n    });\n    // Ordena do mais recente para o mais antigo\n    return Object.entries(groups).sort((a, b) => new Date(b[0]).getTime() - new Date(a[0]).getTime());\n  };\n\n };\n\n  const generatePDF = (items: Transaction[], customerName: string) => {\n    const doc = new jsPDF();\n    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');\n    doc.setFillColor(249, 115, setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } finally { setIsSaving(false); }\n  };\n\n  const executeDelete = async (id: string) => {\n    if (!deleteTransaction) return;\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await deleteTransaction(id);\n      setConfirmAction(null);\n      setMenuOpenId(null);\n    } catch (e) {\n      alert(\"Erro ao excluir.\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n Tente usar uma imagem menor que 2MB.\");\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const reader = new FileReader();\n      reader.onload = (readerEvent) => {\n        const img = new Image();\n        img.onload = () => {\n          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n          // Aggressive compression for mobile networks and database limits\n          const MAX_WIDTH = 600; \n          let width = img.width;\n          let height = img.height;\n          \n          if (width > MAX_WIDTH) {\n            height = (MAX_WIDTH / width) * height;\n            width = MAX_WIDTH;\n          }\n          \n          canvas.width = width;\n          canvas.height = height;\n          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');\n          ctx?.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);\n          // High compression (0.6)\n          const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.6);\n          setLocalConfig(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: dataUrl }));\n        };\n        img.src = readerEvent.target?.result as string;\n      };\n      reader.readAsDataURL(file);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const currentTotal = useMemo(() => {\n    if (activeTab === 'VENDAS') {\n       return section.items.reduce((acc, item) => {\n          const data = stallData[item.id] || {};\n          \n          // Require explicit returned value to calculate sale\n          const returnedStr = (data as any).returned;\n          if (returnedStr === undefined || returnedStr === '') {\n             return acc;\n          }\n\n          const defaultTook = item.defaultQty ? isGodModeUnlocked?: boolean;\n  onUnlockGodMode: () => void;\n}\n\nconst PlanCountDown: React.FC<{ expiresAt?: string; light?: boolean }> = ({ expiresAt, light }) => {\n  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState<{ d: number; h: number; m: number } | null>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!expiresAt) return;\n    const update = () => {\n      const diff = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - new Date().getTime();\n      if (diff <= 0) { setTimeLeft(null); return; }\n      setTimeLeft({\n        d: Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)),\n        h: Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60)),\n        m: Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60))\n      });\n    };\n    update();\n    const interval = setInterval(update, 60000);\n    return () => clearInterval(interval);\n  }, [expiresAt]);\n\n  if (!timeLeft) return <span className=\"text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-rose-500\">Expirado</span>;\n\n  return (\n    <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border ${light ?  const pending = localStorage.getItem('settings_pending_tab');\n    if (pending) {\n      localStorage.removeItem('settings_pending_tab');\n      return pending as any;\n    }\n    return BUSCA NO SUPABASE (Com margem de segurança para Timezone)\n      const userWid = String(currentUser.workspaceId || '').trim().toLowerCase();\n      \n      let query = supabase\n        .from('transactions')\n        .select('*')\n        .eq('workspace_id', userWid)\n        .eq('is_pending', false); // Apenas confirmados\n\n      if (period !== 'all') {\n        // BUFFER DE SEGURANÇA: Subtrai 24h do início e soma 24h no fim para garantir\n        // que fusos horários (UTC vs Local) não cortem dados. A filtragem fina é feita no JS.\n        const safeStart = new Date(startTime - 86400000).toISOString();\n        const safeEnd = new Date(endTime + 86400000).toISOString();\n        \n        query = query.gte('date', safeStart).lte('date', safeEnd);\n      }\n\n      console.log(`[DEBUG_RELATORIO] Iniciando busca... Periodo: ${period}, Wid: ${userWid}`);\n      const { data: rawTransactions, error } = await query;\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"[DEBUG_RELATORIO] Erro Supabase:\", error);\n        throw error;\n      }\n\n      if (!rawTransactions || rawTransactions.length === 0) {\n          alert(\"Nenhum dado financeiro encontrado no servidor para o período selecionado.\");\n          setIsProcessing(false);\n          return;\n      }\n\n      console.log(`[DEBUG_RELATORIO] Dados brutos recebidos: ${rawTransactions.length} registros.`);\n\n      // 3. Filtragem Fina (Javascript)\n      // Remove o excesso trazido pelo buffer de segurança\n      const fetchedTransactions: Transaction[] = rawTransactions\n        .map((t: any) => ({\n          id: String(t.id),\n          workspaceId: t.workspace_id,\n          date: t.date, // ISO String\n          category: String(t.category || ''),\n          subCategory: String(t.sub_category || '').toUpperCase(),\n          item: t.item,\n          value: Number(t.value),\n          quantity: t.quantity,\n          paymentMethod: t.payment_method,\n          customerName: t.customer_name,\n          isPending: t.is_pending,\n          createdBy: t.created_by\n        }))\n        .filter(t => {\n           if (period === 'all') return true;\n           const tTime = new Date(t.date).getTime();\n           return tTime >= startTime && tTime <= endTime;\n        });\n\n      console.log(`[DEBUG_RELATORIO] Após filtro de data JS: ${fetchedTransactions.length} registros.`);\n\n      if (fetchedTransactions.length === 0) {\n         alert(\"Nenhuma transação encontrada neste intervalo exato de datas/horas.\");\n         setIsProcessing(false);\n         return;\n      }\n\n      // 4. [Outros handlers existentes]\n\n  const handleAddSection = async () => {\n    if (!newSectionName) return;\n    setIsProcessing(true);\n    const newSec: AppSection = {\n      id: `sec_${Date.now()}`,\n      workspaceId: currentUser.workspaceId,\n      name: newSectionName,\n      type: newSectionType,\n      order: sections.length,\n      items: [],\n      expenses: [],\n      globalStockMode: 'GLOBAL'\n    };\n    try {\n      const success = await saveConfig([...sections, newSec]);\n      if (success) {\n        setNewSectionName('');\n      } else {\n        alert(\"Erro ao criar aba.  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n          const MAX_WIDTH = 400; // Resize to max width 400px\n          let width = img.width;\n          let height = img.height;\n          \n          if (width > MAX_WIDTH) {\n            height = (MAX_WIDTH / width) * height;\n            width = MAX_WIDTH;\n          }\n          \n          canvas.width = width;\n          canvas.height =
